description: This is a C# source file containing the implementation of a web service class `CatalogViewModelService`, which provides methods to retrieve catalog items, brands, and types for an e-commerce web application. It interacts with repositories and constructs view models for UI rendering.

classes.name: CatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A UI-specific service class that provides methods to fetch catalog data, brands, and types for the web application's front-end. It leverages repositories and supports asynchronous operations.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a paginated list of catalog items filtered by brand and type, constructing a view model with catalog items, filters, and pagination info.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of brand options for filtering, including an 'All' option.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of type options for filtering, including an 'All' option.
